title: Maz Kanata
subtitle: Eclectic Pirate Queen
text: Action [Exhaust]: Play a Fringe or Underworld unit from your hand. It costs 1 resource less. Give a Weakness token to it.
deployBox:
Hidden (This unit can't be attacked if she was deployed this phase.)
Action: Play a Fringe or Underworld unit from your hand. It costs 1 resource less. Give a Weakness token to it.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
Maz's action ability cannot be used as an action if you don't play a unit, as it would not change the game state.
If a unit has Hidden and Sentinel at the same time, it can be attacked.
